This certificate verifies that the product samples listed below have been tested in accordance with laboratory protocols and applicable 
international standards. The results confirm conformity to the specified requirements for safety, performance, and material reliability.
All required certification tests, including capacitance stability, leakage
current, long-duration load life simulation, and thermal cycling endurance,
were conducted by ApexTest Laboratories – Electronics Division, an
independent facility accredited under ISO/IEC 17025:2017. The evaluation
confirmed full conformity with IEC 60384-4 requirements and RoHS 2011/65/
EU restrictions, with no deviations or nonconformities identified.
Address: 4200 Tech Valley Road, Capitol City, USA
